show.description: Raju, a curious son who suspects his father Mahesh’s famous parathas hide a terrifying secret. As Raju uncovers the dark truth behind the family’s thriving food business and Mahesh’s strange bond with Priya, the kitchen turns into a battleground of trust, fear, and survival.
